title: ADI Communications & Gary Pearce — Master 100-Platform Free Image Stacking Registry
description: Comprehensive directory of 100 free image hosting, storage, and community platforms with API capabilities, public URL types, retention limits, and Rule 45 Google Shield link targets.

classification_standard.type_a_direct_url: Direct image file delivery (CDN / raw image) viewable anywhere.
classification_standard.type_b_public_page: Standalone public webpage featuring title, description, and rendered image.
classification_standard.type_c_clickable_backlink: Public webpage with an active clickable external anchor passing referral traffic and SEO entity signals.
